name: o-json: choose and open a file

actions.label: Keep the current document
actions.caption: esc closes the chooser and keeps the open document. Use it when you decide against switching files.

actions.label: Choose the previous file
actions.caption: ctrl+j moves down once; ctrl+k moves back up. Use it to correct a choice without closing the chooser.

actions.label: Choose the next file
actions.caption: ctrl+j moves down the file choices. Check the highlighted name before you open it.

actions.label: Show recent files
actions.caption: ctrl+o switches from browsing folders to recent files. Use it to reopen a document without remembering its path.

actions.label: Browse inside a folder
actions.caption: Type jobs, then ctrl+l opens that folder. Browse its JSON files before choosing which job to inspect.

actions.label: Open the highlighted file
actions.caption: Type nested, then alt+enter picks that JSON file. The chooser closes and o-json shows its structure.

actions.label: Choose the previous source
actions.caption: alt+o cycles backward through file sources. Use the typed-path source when you already know the filename.

actions.label: Browse the parent folder
actions.caption: Type jobs and press ctrl+l to enter it; alt+up returns to the sample folder. Use it to recover your place while browsing.

actions.label: Match a partial filename
actions.caption: Type smpl, then shift+tab chooses substring matching and tab returns to fuzzy. Find sample.json even when you remember only some letters.

actions.label: Match with a different search style
actions.caption: Type sample, then shift+tab cycles filename matching backward. Choose the style that fits the text you remember.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
